{{Quote|Beep boo weep. Twee twee.|A Duwani Mechanical Products 3C-series utility droid|<ref name="KOTOR II">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Duwani Mechanical Products''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing company active during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Founded well before the [[Gank Massacres]] of [[4800 BBY]], the company specialized in the production of [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility]] and [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], but it also produced various models of rugged and utilitarian [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]], [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]], [[mining droid]]s, and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. Duwani remained in business throughout conflicts such as the [[Jedi Civil War]], the [[Dark Wars]], and the [[Great Galactic War]], and two of its products&mdash;the [[T3-series utility droid]] [[T3-M4]] and the [[T7-series astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]]&mdash;played pivotal roles in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] events during their lifetimes. However, Duwani eventually went out of business sometime before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and its products were rarely seen outside of private collections by the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
{{Quote|TARIS: We received a dreadful welcome when T3 droids at the starport made off with our baggage.|''[[Trampeta's Star Guide]]''|<ref name="NEGTD" />}}
A [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturing corporation that also produced [[Computer/Legends|computer]] systems and droid repair equipment,<ref name="Tales of the Jedi" /> Duwani Mechanical Products was founded well before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4800 BBY]], when it was commissioned by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Vocatara]] to produce the [[juggernaut war droid]] to aid the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|rocket-jumper corps]] in the conflict known as the [[Gank Massacres]].<ref name="NEGTD" /> In the [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] that followed, Duwani became one of the most successful companies in the droid market alongside the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] and the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]], and it maintained its position in the [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="Scavenger" /> The company's logo resembled a light [[Color/Legends|blue]] ellipse containing numerous lines, and several dark red streaks stemmed from each side of the ellipse.<ref name="NEGTD" />

It continued to produce [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droids]], [[mining droid]]s, and other models throughout the next several [[Time/Legends|centuries]], surviving the [[Mandalorian Wars]], [[Jedi Civil War]], and the [[Dark Wars]]&mdash;a series of conflicts that occurred in the decades after 4000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. Duwani acquired the T1-series trademark from [[Kellenech Technologies]] after their [[LB-series bulk-loading droid]] fell out of popularity<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" /> over a century before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] between the Republic and various [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] factions,<ref name="NEGTD" /> and the company used it for its flagship [[T1-series utility droid]]. Duwani's [[T3-series utility droid]],<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" /> which went into production sometime before [[4086 BBY]], was one of the earliest predecessors to the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], and the company continued to improve upon the T3-series over the next century.<ref name="NEGTD" />

[[File:T701-TOR.png|thumb|right|150px|T7-O1, a T7-series astromech around the time of the Great Galactic War]]
The [[T7-series astromech droid]] was a model offered around a century after the Dark Wars, and droids of similar design were common throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> In the years after the Mandalorian Wars, [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] began to retrofit utility droids with [[starfighter interface package]]s, allowing their droids to plug directly into their [[Starship/Legends|ships]], although Duwani did not officially endorse such modifications.<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" /> By the time of the Republic's reorganization into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Duwani had long been out of business, and models such as the T3-series were rarely seen outside of private collections by the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="NEGTD" />

==Products==
{{Quote|Statement: Oh, do shut up, you beeping little trash compactor.|The assassin droid [[HK-47]], to T3-M4|<ref name="KOTOR II" />}}
The company's droids were known for their utilitarian and minimalist design, but early Duwani models were durable and efficient.<ref name="Scavenger" /> In the years before the Great Sith War, Duwani produced the [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[3DO protocol/service droid]]; the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Andur Sunrider]] purchased [[A-3DO]] for 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] several years before 4,000 BBY.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi" /> Around the same time, Duwani offered the [[UniSlice]]&mdash;a compact device that jammed electronic systems while a low-power [[energy torch]] cut through locking mechanisms&mdash;for 2,000 [[Currency/Legends|credits]], as well as the [[Breather-1]], a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] costing 150 credits.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi" /> [[Security cardlock breaker|Security code breakers]] like the UniSlice were considered to be archaic by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] some four thousand years later, though, as many places in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] relied on older security measures; the UniSlice continued to see frequent use for breaking and entering.<ref name="Gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

One of the earliest Duwani products<ref name="NEGTD" /> was the juggernaut war droid, a combat model designed specifically as a remote resupply and combat droid for the Republic's rocket-jumper corps. The droids became a common sight on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], serving as part of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] defense forces, but that ended when the [[HK-01]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] reprogrammed many juggernauts during the [[Great Droid Revolution]] of [[4015 BBY]]. Most juggernaut war droids had their [[Intelligence matrix|intelligence matrices]] removed, and production of the droids ceased<ref name="NEGTD" /> as many active units were retired.<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" /> Another droid produced by Duwani in the years before the Mandalorian Wars was the popular [[DP-2 probe droid]], a large ovoid model intended for use by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and explorers in the deep of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The [[KM1 mining droid]] was a crab-like model that saw great use in the Outer Rim Territories at [[Mining/Legends|mining]] complexes such as the [[Peragus Mining Facility]].<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" />

[[File:T3M4-NEGD.png|thumb|left|160px|Duwani's popular T3-series utility droid]]
With the production of the T1-series, Duwani pioneered the new class of utility droid, and subsequent models such as the [[3C-series utility droid|3C-series]], [[IT-series utility droid|IT-series]], and T3-series utility droid built on the T1's success. Duwani's utility droids were easily recognizable by their four-wheeled legs, flat rotating head, and short stature.<ref name="KOTOR II" /> [[T3-M4]] was a T3-series droid who became a companion of the famous Jedi [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] during the Jedi Civil War,<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> and he continued to serve aboard Revan's ship, the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', even after the Jedi disappeared, working alongside Revan's ally [[Meetra Surik]] during the Dark Wars.<ref name="KOTOR II" />

In the years after the Dark Wars, Duwani continued to refine and produce droids,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> eventually shifting from utility droids to the more starship-capable astromech droids,<ref name="KOTOR Campaign" /> and its T7-series astromech droid went into production around a century after the Jedi Civil War. Another Duwani droid, the T7-series astromech [[T7-O1]], was in operation for more than two centuries after his creation, and he became a companion of the legendary [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] while the [[Galactic War]] broke out between the Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in [[3641 BBY]].<ref name="Treaty">{{TOR_dates|Treaty}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Duwani Mechanical Products was first mentioned in the ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', a roleplaying reference book published by [[West End Games]] in [[1996]] as a tie-in to the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi" />
